scientific_integrity: One exact theorem, analytic proof and independently reproducible standard-library decimal diagnostics; no claims of independent certification, authorship, or external validation.
scientific_limitations: The product is a nontrivial closed summation of the previously established Gnedin-Olshanski one-point displacement law; no claim of independence among different-site displacements.
Absolute convergence is asserted only for q<|z|<1/q with 0<q<1.
Historical priority may be affected by an unidentified equivalent product evaluation.
title: Geometric-difference law and strict parity monotonicity for stationary Mallows displacement
